headline: Bank of Japan Releases October Senior Loan Officer Survey and Accounts Data
summary: The Bank of Japan issued its October accounts statement, securities financing transactions data, and its quarterly Senior Loan Officer Opinion Survey covering domestic banking trends.
why: Bank of Japan lending data provides key evidence on credit demand and domestic financial conditions as the central bank normalizes its monetary policy settings.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Lending sentiment and balance sheet statistics inform expectations regarding future Bank of Japan policy adjustments.
